steps.title: Why this matters
steps.body: Most games at this level are decided by one piece left hanging. Before every move, ask two questions: what can they take, and what can I take? This habit alone wins more games than any opening.
Look at the black queen on d5. Is anything protecting it?

wrong.default: Check what is attacked and unprotected. One of your pieces can take something for free.

steps.onSuccess: Nothing could recapture, so the queen was free.

options: it is attacked and can be taken without loss to the attacker
it is far from the king
steps.why: Free material decides games. Look for it on both sides.

cards.prompt: What does the Safety Check ask?
solution: What can they take, and what can I take?
cards.why: Looking both ways catches most blunders.
